purpose: Enable and qualify the bounded same-version AC1024 inline SAB v700 to DXF SAT 700 carrier route while preserving incomplete whole-source refusal.

entity.payloadHeader: ACIS BinaryFile v700, zero record count, one entity, zero flags

files.src/libdxfrw.cpp: Adds a strict AC1024-only qualification for a marker-bounded, exact inline SAB v700 3DSOLID with modeler version 2, zero SAB record count, one declared entity/body, zero flags, a complete terminal parse, no DataStorage tail, and a source range contained by the retained DWG frame. The admitted payload is converted to SAT 700 and emitted with DXF group 70 value 1. Existing AC1021/v21200 and later AC1027+ routes are unchanged.
files.tests/dwg_local_roundtrip_tests.cpp: Adds a generated no-fixture writer test for ASCII/Binary AC1024 output, typed readback, import-export-import preservation, EED APPID closure, missing-APPID atomic refusal, and AC1027 cross-version atomic refusal.
files.tests/CMakeLists.txt: Registers the generated control as the focused dwg_ac1024_acis700_sat_dxf_roundtrip test with fast/dwg/dxf/3d/acis/generated labels.

implementation.profileBoundary: Only the observed zero-count, one-body ACIS 700 AC1024 3DSOLID carrier is admitted for target AC1024. Other target versions, entities, modeler flags, header values, source-frame ranges, and unqualified data-storage profiles remain refused.

physicalSourceRead.command: temporary dx_iface probe: fileImport source DWG; copy only parsed 3DSOLID and source APPID table into a fresh dx_data; fileExport to AC1024; fileImport output
physicalSourceRead.completeDwGDisposition: Strict whole-file export refused: two retained AcDb:Header integrity diagnostics remain (observed length 825 vs expected 821 at offset 16; observed 1582 vs expected 843 at offset 843). This refusal is retained.
physicalSourceRead.dependencyClosure: The selected entity's EED references ACAD_OBJECT_CHANGE_GUID. The fresh selected-output container included the source APPID table; output without APPID registration is refused by the writer.

generatedControl.command: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dwg_local_roundtrip libdxfrw_acis_sat_allocation_tests -j4 && ctest --test-dir build-gcc -R '^(dwg_ac1024_acis700_sat_dxf_roundtrip|acis_sat_allocation_rollback_retry)$' --output-on-failure
generatedControl.result: PASS 2/2 (0.61 seconds). The AC1024 ASCII/Binary carrier imports, exports, reads back, and survives import-export-import. Missing APPID and AC1027 cross-version output refuse atomically. The serializer allocation/retry control passes.

limitations: The source DWG was generated by ODA from a public SAT sample and is not an Autodesk-native producer witness.
The selected entity output control is not whole-document conversion; strict whole-file export remains blocked by the two source header integrity diagnostics.

A bounded SAT carrier roundtrip does not prove native geometry semantics, topology, or B-rep support. See the separate FreeCAD cube receipt for selected native Part results and its shared-kernel limitation.
No external DWG, DXF, or SAT fixture was added to the repository.
claimEffect: Adds a bounded same-version AC1024 v700 3DSOLID-to-SAT DXF carrier route with selected source readback and APPID dependency closure. It does not qualify complete-document output or promote general DWG/DXF/ACIS/3D support claims.
